== Walkthrough ==

''[[Niola Impholder]] is located at 795, -599, 3 in the Felwithe Magician's Guild.''

You say, 'Hail, Niola Impholder'

: Niola Impholder says, 'Greetings, ______. Welcome to the home of the Keepers of the Art. I am in need of spell components. Would you be willing to [fetch] some for me?' 

You say, 'I will fetch components'

: Niola Impholder says, 'What I need are some bat wings for a spell I am researching. If you bring me back four bat wings, I would be willing to reward you with a scroll.'

'''Hand [[Niola Impholder]] 4 [[Bat Wing]]s, unstacked.'''

: Niola Impholder says, 'Ah yes. These are exactly what I need. Thank you very much.'

<div class="facblock">
* Your faction standing with [[Keepers of the Art]] got better.
* Your faction standing with [[King Tearis Thex]] got better.
* Your faction standing with [[Faydarks Champions]] got better.
* Your faction standing with [[The Dead]] got worse.
</div>
